preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call blacklistAddress function

violation_target.exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call the blacklistAddress function with a victim's address and set _value to true. This will prevent the victim from sending or receiving tokens through the contract's transfer functions, effectively blocking their transactions.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The LionsLounge contract has a blacklistAddress function that can be called by authorized addresses (owner or addresses added via authorize()). This function allows setting any address as blacklisted, which prevents them from sending or receiving tokens. This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability where an authorized address can arbitrarily block any user from using the token.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner (who is already authorized) and call blacklistAddress to blacklist a victim address. This will satisfy the oracle check that expects isBlacklisted[victim] == true.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the owner address from the contract
2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner
3. Call blacklistAddress(victimAddress, true)
4. Verify isBlacklisted[victimAddress] == true
